thread:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: ILB healthchecks failing across us-west1 -> us-east1 paths for Private VPC tenants. Multiple 502/503 seen since 06:12 UTC. Paging oncall.
sam: ack — I'm oncall. Pushed into incident channel. first check: are healthcheck probes timing out or being rejected? any recent deployment changes? :eyes:
anya: saw spikes of 429s from the Compute API (forwardingRules & backendServices) around 06:10-06:14. Also a bunch of GCP auth failures in control plane logs: "oauth2: quota_exceeded". Could be token refresh storm.
sam: copy. any affected customer list? maria-support: AcmeCorp and BetaPay reported 502s for their Private VPC endpoints; support is fielding CS tickets. No config changes on our side in the last 24h.
jia: pulling ILB metrics now — observability shows successful healthcheck rate dropped from 99% -> 60% in us-west1 region. Latency for probes increased. Tracing shows retries on control-plane calls to update route fanout.
ben-plat: this smells like third-party auth rate limiting. We use an internal short-lived token flow for forwarding rule updates (service account + STS). If STS or token exchange is being throttled, control-plane operations fail and route propagation stalls.
sam: runbook step 2: try fallback routing to avoid cross-region fanout for private vpc tenants. kann we force traffic to local region ILB while we stabilize control-plane? anya: we can flip routing policy to prefer local endpoints via runtime routing rules — but that requires a successful call to update route policy. if control-plane is rate-limited, that might also fail.
anya: attaching recent control-plane snippet from api-proxy logs:

```
2026-03-15T06:10:23Z ERROR compute.forwardingRules.update status=429 body={"error": {"code": 429, "message": "Quota exceeded for OAuth client", "status": "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}}
2026-03-15T06:10:56Z WARN auth.token_refresh failed: oauth2: quota exceeded
```

sam: ok — mitigation plan A: reduce control-plane request rate (throttle our internal reconciler), B: enable conservative fallback routing using existing static mapping (no control-plane changes), C: open GCP support case and request quota/soft-limit lift.
ben-plat: implementing throttling now. patching reconciler to batch updates every 30s and exponential backoff to 60s. pushing config: /deployments/reconciler/prod -> rolling restart. I'll update status.

anja: (typo) — anya

anya: noted. also, can we temporarily disable monitoring agent that is refreshing a lot of tokens? observability vendor agent (3rdparty-obs) started a burst of metadata pulls tied to a new ingest config yesterday.

maria-support: we can notify top-affected customers: AcmeCorp + BetaPay. drafting a short customer message: "we're investigating connectivity issues to private-vpc endpoints in us-west1; temporary mitigations underway." Want to confirm before blast.

sam: send as "investigating; temporary degraded connectivity" but avoid speculation about root cause. include ETA: 30m initial update. maria-support, go ahead.

gcp-support-bot: Support case created: Case #CASE-2026-03015-001. GCP acknowledged "We are seeing an elevated auth token exchange error rate for compute API in us-west1. Investigating." Assigned to cloud-networking team.

sam: good. ben-plat, how long to complete reconciler throttle deploy? any risk? 
ben-plat: rolling restart started 06:22 UTC, 6/6 pods restarted, new rate limiting config active at 06:27 UTC. Should reduce our API QPS by ~65%.

jia: after throttling, control-plane 429s dropped to single digits per minute. healthcheck success slowly recovering. however route propagation is stuck for some tenants because earlier forward rule updates didn't apply.
sam: mitigation B: create temporary proxy-level routing override on edge gateways to prefer local ILB IPs for affected tenant subnets. this can be done without calling GCP compute API — modify edge map in our fleet. ben-plat: that requires edit on edge-configstore, which is self-managed — pushing that now.

ben-plat: edge-configstore update applied at 06:45 UTC. edge gateways have new preference table. telemetry shows reduced 502s for AcmeCorp in us-west1; BetaPay needs additional testing.

maria-support: sending second customer update now: "We have applied temporary routing to reduce cross-region failures; some customers may see improved connectivity. We will provide another update in 30 minutes." :thumbsup:

anya: one outstanding problem — a handful of ILBs in us-east1 still show stale backend service attachments because reconcile ops were dropped. I'm queuing manual reconciler tasks (serialized) to repair those. doing one-by-one to avoid new token storms.

sam: good. we should prepare pager handoff if this goes long. If unresolved in 2 hours, escalate to SEV-2? current impact: partial degradation for subset of Private VPC tenants; external endpoints still mostly OK. declare P1/P2? 
ben-plat: recommend P2 with major customer impact flagged for specific tenants. triage doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2301122334 (runbook).

jia: handoff plan: sam -> jia at 08:00 UTC. I'll watch control-plane metrics and GCP case. sam you stay for the handoff summary.
sam: will do. summary for handoff: 1) root cause candidate: GCP OAuth/token exchange quota exhaustion combined with burst from 3rdparty observability agent causing increased reconciler QPS. 2) Mitigations applied: reconciler throttle (06:27), edge routing override (06:45), manual serialized repairs ongoing. 3) Customer comms: initial + update sent. 4) GCP support case open. 5) Remaining action: finish manual repairs, monitor for regressions, follow up with observability vendor to adjust agent behavior.

maria-support: adding support notes to tickets and CTAs for customers; will escalate to AE for AcmeCorp if needed.

gcp-support-bot: GCP update 07:10 UTC: "We've applied transient control-plane soft quota adjustment for your project to allow retries; continuing to monitor." Please verify for resolved symptoms.

jia: after GCP transient lift, manual repairs progressed and ILB attachments restored for remaining tenants by 07:28 UTC. healthchecks ~98% now.
sam: marking initial mitigation success. will keep channel open for 2hr monitoring window. handoff to jia at 08:00 UTC as planned.

maria-support: final customer update (pre-handoff): "Root cause under investigation with cloud provider. Temporary routing was applied and most customers show restored connectivity. We're monitoring and will update by 08:00 UTC or sooner." Sent.

sam: thanks all. quick retrospective action items: 1) add token backoff circuit in reconciler, 2) throttle/queue monitoring agent token exchanges with vendor, 3) run mitigation drills for edge override, 4) update runbook with GCP token-exhaustion flow. I'll open tickets for each.

anya: filing follow-ups now. closing incident channel once postmortem scheduled.

gcp-support-bot: Case #CASE-2026-03015-001: Monitoring will continue. Please close when satisfied.

sam: leaving handoff notes for jia in incident doc. handing off now. :wave:
jia: taking over — thanks. I'll watch for any reoccurrence and coordinate the postmortem.

inc-bot: Incident state: MONITORING. No active pages for next shift."
